fact.en: Carbon is a nonmetal in Group 4A with atomic number 6, so a neutral carbon atom has six protons and six electrons.
fact.tl: Ang carbon ay isang nonmetal sa Group 4A na may atomic number 6, kaya ang neutral na carbon atom ay may anim na proton at anim na electron.
fact.bis: Ang carbon usa ka nonmetal sa Group 4A nga adunay atomic number 6, busa ang neutral nga carbon atom adunay unom ka proton ug unom ka electron.

cards.illustration: A simple diagram of a carbon atom with six protons and six neutrons in the nucleus, and six electrons in two surrounding energy levels.

fact.en:
Why can carbon form so many different compounds?

Because it has four valence electrons - the electrons in its outermost shell - ready to be shared with other atoms.
fact.tl:
Bakit napakaraming iba't ibang compound ang kayang gawin ng carbon?

Dahil mayroon itong apat na valence electron - ang mga electron sa pinakalabas na shell nito - na handang ibahagi sa ibang atoms.
fact.bis:
Ngano nga daghan kaayog lain-laing compound ang mahimo sa carbon?

Tungod kay kini adunay upat ka valence electron - ang mga electron sa pinakagawas nga shell - nga andam ipaambit sa laing mga atoms.

cards.illustration: A carbon atom with its outermost shell highlighted, showing four electrons on the outer ring.

fact.en: Carbon shares its four valence electrons with other atoms to form covalent bonds, reaching a stable arrangement.
fact.tl: Ibinabahagi ng carbon ang apat nitong valence electron sa ibang atoms upang makabuo ng covalent bonds at maging stable.
fact.bis: Ipaambit sa carbon ang upat ka valence electron ngadto sa laing mga atoms aron makahimo og covalent bonds ug mahimong stable.

cards.illustration: Two carbon atoms sharing a pair of electrons between them, drawn as overlapping circles with dots for electrons.

fact.en: Carbon can form single, double, and triple bonds by sharing one, two, or three pairs of electrons with another atom.
fact.tl: Ang carbon ay maaaring bumuo ng single, double, at triple bonds sa pamamagitan ng pagbabahagi ng isa, dalawa, o tatlong pares ng electron sa ibang atom.
fact.bis: Ang carbon makahimo og single, double, ug triple bonds pinaagi sa pagpaambit og usa, duha, o tulo ka pares sa electron sa laing atom.

cards.illustration: Three diagrams side by side showing two atoms connected by one, two, and three shared electron pairs.

fact.en:
Which bond is stronger - a single bond or a triple bond?

A triple bond! More shared electron pairs pull the atoms closer together, making the bond shorter and stronger.
fact.tl:
Aling bond ang mas malakas - single bond o triple bond?

Ang triple bond! Mas maraming shared electron pairs ang humihila sa mga atoms palapit sa isa't isa, kaya mas maikli at mas malakas ang bond.
fact.bis:
Hain nga bond ang mas kusgan - single bond o triple bond?

Ang triple bond! Mas daghang shared electron pairs ang mobira sa mga atoms nga magkaduol, busa mas mubo ug mas kusgan ang bond.

cards.illustration: A ruler comparing the distance between two atoms in a single bond versus a triple bond, with the triple bond atoms closer together.

fact.en: Organic compounds contain carbon-hydrogen bonds, while inorganic compounds generally do not have these bonds.
fact.tl: Ang organic compounds ay naglalaman ng carbon-hydrogen bonds, samantalang ang inorganic compounds ay karaniwang walang ganitong mga bond.
fact.bis: Ang organic compounds adunay carbon-hydrogen bonds, samtang ang inorganic compounds sa kinatibuk-an wala niining mga bond.

cards.illustration: Two labeled jars, one containing a clear organic liquid like oil and the other containing salt crystals, showing the difference.

fact.en: Organic compounds tend to have low melting and boiling points, burn in air, and dissolve in nonpolar solvents.
fact.tl: Ang organic compounds ay karaniwang may mababang melting at boiling points, nasusunog sa hangin, at natutunaw sa nonpolar solvents.
fact.bis: Ang organic compounds sa kinatibuk-an adunay ubos nga melting ug boiling points, masunog sa hangin, ug matunaw sa nonpolar solvents.

cards.illustration: A candle burning with a small flame, showing an organic compound burning in air.

fact.en: Inorganic compounds often have high melting and boiling points and usually have ionic or polar covalent bonds.
fact.tl: Ang inorganic compounds ay kadalasang may mataas na melting at boiling points at karaniwang may ionic o polar covalent bonds.
fact.bis: Ang inorganic compounds sa kanunay adunay taas nga melting ug boiling points ug sagad adunay ionic o polar covalent bonds.

cards.illustration: A pile of table salt crystals, representing an inorganic compound with high melting point.

fact.en: Hydrocarbons are organic compounds that contain only carbon and hydrogen atoms, and they are classified as alkanes, alkenes, and alkynes.
fact.tl: Ang hydrocarbons ay mga organic compound na naglalaman lamang ng carbon at hydrogen atoms, at inuuri sila bilang alkanes, alkenes, at alkynes.
fact.bis: Ang hydrocarbons mga organic compound nga adunay lamang carbon ug hydrogen atoms, ug giklasipika kini isip alkanes, alkenes, ug alkynes.

cards.illustration: A simple molecular model of methane, showing one carbon atom bonded to four hydrogen atoms.

fact.en: Alkanes have single bonds between carbon atoms, alkenes have double bonds, and alkynes have triple bonds.
fact.tl: Ang alkanes ay may single bonds sa pagitan ng carbon atoms, ang alkenes ay may double bonds, at ang alkynes ay may triple bonds.
fact.bis: Ang alkanes adunay single bonds tali sa carbon atoms, ang alkenes adunay double bonds, ug ang alkynes adunay triple bonds.

cards.illustration: Three simple line drawings of carbon chains: one with single lines, one with a double line, and one with a triple line between carbons.

fact.en: The general formulas are CnH2n+2 for alkanes, CnH2n for alkenes, and CnH2n-2 for alkynes, where n is the number of carbon atoms.
fact.tl: Ang general formulas ay CnH2n+2 para sa alkanes, CnH2n para sa alkenes, at CnH2n-2 para sa alkynes, kung saan ang n ay ang bilang ng carbon atoms.
fact.bis: Ang general formulas mao ang CnH2n+2 para sa alkanes, CnH2n para sa alkenes, ug CnH2n-2 para sa alkynes, diin ang n mao ang gidaghanon sa carbon atoms.

cards.illustration: A chalkboard showing the three general formulas written out with a small example molecule next to each.

fact.en:
What is a common use of methane?

Methane is used as a fuel! It is the main component of natural gas that we burn for cooking and heating.
fact.tl:
Ano ang karaniwang gamit ng methane?

Ginagamit ang methane bilang panggatong! Ito ang pangunahing sangkap ng natural gas na sinusunog natin sa pagluluto at pag-init.
fact.bis:
Unsa ang kasagarang gamit sa methane?

Gigamit ang methane isip sugnod! Kini ang pangunang sangkap sa natural gas nga atong sunugon sa pagluto ug pagpainit.

cards.illustration: A gas stove burner with a blue flame, representing methane burning as fuel.

fact.en: Viscosity is a liquid's resistance to flow, and viscous organic compounds like cooking oil flow slowly.
fact.tl: Ang viscosity ay ang paglaban ng likido sa pagdaloy, at ang malapot na organic compounds tulad ng mantika ay mabagal dumaloy.
fact.bis: Ang viscosity mao ang pagsukol sa likido sa pag-agay, ug ang lagkit nga organic compounds sama sa mantika hinay nga moagay.

cards.illustration: A drop of thick cooking oil slowly sliding down an inclined surface, showing its resistance to flow.

fact.en: Volatility is how easily a liquid evaporates, and volatile organic compounds like alcohol turn into vapor quickly.
fact.tl: Ang volatility ay kung gaano kadaling sumingaw ang isang likido, at ang volatile organic compounds tulad ng alcohol ay mabilis nagiging singaw.
fact.bis: Ang volatility mao kung unsa kadali moalisngaw ang usa ka likido, ug ang volatile organic compounds sama sa alcohol dali nga mahimong alisngaw.

cards.illustration: A small puddle of rubbing alcohol on a table with faint wavy lines rising from it, showing evaporation.

fact.en:
Why is smoking not allowed at gasoline stations?

Because gasoline is flammable - it can easily catch fire and cause a dangerous blaze!
fact.tl:
Bakit bawal manigarilyo sa gasoline stations?

Dahil ang gasoline ay flammable - madali itong magliyab at magdulot ng mapanganib na sunog!
fact.bis:
Ngano nga bawal manigarilyo sa gasoline stations?

Tungod kay ang gasoline flammable - dali kini nga mosilaob ug makapahinabog peligrosong sunog!

cards.illustration: A gasoline pump with a no-smoking sign, emphasizing the danger of fire.

fact.en: Isopropyl alcohol is an organic compound used as a disinfectant to kill harmful germs on skin and surfaces.
fact.tl: Ang isopropyl alcohol ay isang organic compound na ginagamit bilang disinfectant upang patayin ang mapaminsalang mikrobyo sa balat at mga bagay.
fact.bis: Ang isopropyl alcohol usa ka organic compound nga gigamit isip disinfectant aron patyon ang makadaot nga kagaw sa panit ug mga butang.

cards.illustration: A hand being sprayed with isopropyl alcohol from a small bottle, showing its use as a disinfectant.

fact.en: Ethanol, also called ethyl alcohol, is an organic compound used as a disinfectant, a fuel, and a component in beverages.
fact.tl: Ang ethanol, na tinatawag ding ethyl alcohol, ay isang organic compound na ginagamit bilang disinfectant, panggatong, at sangkap sa mga inumin.
fact.bis: Ang ethanol, gitawag usab nga ethyl alcohol, usa ka organic compound nga gigamit isip disinfectant, sugnod, ug sangkap sa mga ilimnon.

cards.illustration: A bottle of rubbing alcohol next to a small glass of clear beverage, showing two uses of ethanol.

fact.en: Acetone is an organic compound commonly used as a cleaner, especially for removing nail polish.
fact.tl: Ang acetone ay isang organic compound na karaniwang ginagamit bilang panlinis, lalo na sa pagtanggal ng nail polish.
fact.bis: Ang acetone usa ka organic compound nga sagad gigamit isip panglimpyo, ilabi na sa pagtangtang sa nail polish.

cards.illustration: A cotton ball soaked in acetone being wiped over a painted fingernail, removing the polish.

fact.en: Kerosene is an organic compound used as a fuel for lamps and stoves, providing light and heat.
fact.tl: Ang kerosene ay isang organic compound na ginagamit bilang panggatong sa mga lampara at kalan, na nagbibigay ng liwanag at init.
fact.bis: Ang kerosene usa ka organic compound nga gigamit isip sugnod sa mga lampara ug kalan, nga naghatag og kahayag ug kainit.

cards.illustration: A traditional oil lamp with a small flame, using kerosene as fuel.

fact.en: Liquefied Petroleum Gas, or LPG, is an organic compound used as a fuel for cooking in many homes.
fact.tl: Ang Liquefied Petroleum Gas, o LPG, ay isang organic compound na ginagamit bilang panggatong sa pagluluto sa maraming tahanan.
fact.bis: Ang Liquefied Petroleum Gas, o LPG, usa ka organic compound nga gigamit isip sugnod sa pagluto sa daghang panimalay.

cards.illustration: A gas stove connected to an LPG tank, with a pot on the burner.

fact.en: Gasoline is an organic compound used as a fuel in automobile vehicles to make engines run.
fact.tl: Ang gasoline ay isang organic compound na ginagamit bilang panggatong sa mga sasakyan upang patakbuhin ang mga makina.
fact.bis: Ang gasoline usa ka organic compound nga gigamit isip sugnod sa mga sakyanan aron mapadagan ang mga makina.

cards.illustration: A car at a gas station with the fuel nozzle inserted into the tank.

fact.en: Acetic acid is an organic compound found in vinegar, giving it a sour taste and used in food preparation.
fact.tl: Ang acetic acid ay isang organic compound na matatagpuan sa suka, na nagbibigay ng maasim na lasa at ginagamit sa paghahanda ng pagkain.
fact.bis: Ang acetic acid usa ka organic compound nga makita sa suka, nga naghatag og aslom nga lami ug gigamit sa pag-andam sa pagkaon.

cards.illustration: A bottle of vinegar next to a bowl of salad, showing acetic acid in food.

fact.en: Organic compounds like nucleic acids, proteins, lipids, and carbohydrates are found in all living organisms.
fact.tl: Ang mga organic compound tulad ng nucleic acids, proteins, lipids, at carbohydrates ay matatagpuan sa lahat ng nabubuhay na organismo.
fact.bis: Ang mga organic compound sama sa nucleic acids, proteins, lipids, ug carbohydrates makita sa tanang buhing organismo.

title.tl: Organic Compounds sa mga Bagay na May Buhay
title.bis: Organic Compounds sa mga Buhi nga Butang

cards.illustration: A simple diagram of a cell with labeled parts showing different organic compounds like proteins and carbohydrates.

fact.en:
Is carbon dioxide an organic compound?

No! Even though it contains carbon, carbon dioxide has no carbon-hydrogen bonds, so it is inorganic.
fact.tl:
Ang carbon dioxide ba ay isang organic compound?

Hindi! Kahit na naglalaman ito ng carbon, ang carbon dioxide ay walang carbon-hydrogen bonds, kaya ito ay inorganic.
fact.bis:
Ang carbon dioxide ba usa ka organic compound?

Dili! Bisan tuod kini adunay carbon, ang carbon dioxide walay carbon-hydrogen bonds, busa kini inorganic.

cards.illustration: A person exhaling a visible breath on a cold day, showing carbon dioxide as an inorganic gas.

fact.en: Table salt, or sodium chloride, is an inorganic compound with ionic bonds and a high melting point.
fact.tl: Ang table salt, o sodium chloride, ay isang inorganic compound na may ionic bonds at mataas na melting point.
fact.bis: Ang table salt, o sodium chloride, usa ka inorganic compound nga adunay ionic bonds ug taas nga melting point.

cards.illustration: A close-up of white salt crystals in a small dish, showing their cubic shape.

fact.en: The more bonds between two atoms, the shorter and stronger the bond becomes, so triple bonds are shortest and strongest.
fact.tl: Kapag mas maraming bonds sa pagitan ng dalawang atoms, mas maikli at mas malakas ang bond, kaya ang triple bonds ang pinakamaikli at pinakamalakas.
fact.bis: Kon mas daghan ang bonds tali sa duha ka atoms, mas mubo ug mas kusgan ang bond, busa ang triple bonds ang pinakamubo ug pinakakusgan.

cards.illustration: A chart showing three pairs of atoms with increasing number of bonds and decreasing distance between them.

fact.en:
How many bonds can one carbon atom form?

Four! Carbon has four valence electrons to share, so it can form up to four chemical bonds.
fact.tl:
Ilang bonds ang kayang gawin ng isang carbon atom?

Apat! May apat na valence electron ang carbon na maaaring ibahagi, kaya nakakabuo ito ng hanggang apat na chemical bonds.
fact.bis:
Pila ka bonds ang mahimo sa usa ka carbon atom?

Upat! Ang carbon adunay upat ka valence electron nga mahimong ipaambit, busa makahimo kini og hangtod upat ka chemical bonds.

cards.illustration: A central carbon atom with four lines extending outward to four different atoms, showing its bonding capacity.

fact.en: Most organic compounds are nonelectrolytes, meaning they do not conduct electricity when dissolved in water.
fact.tl: Karamihan sa organic compounds ay nonelectrolytes, ibig sabihin hindi sila nagdadala ng kuryente kapag natunaw sa tubig.
fact.bis: Kadaghanan sa organic compounds mga nonelectrolytes, nagpasabot nga dili sila magdala og kuryente kon matunaw sa tubig.

cards.illustration: A simple circuit with a light bulb that does not light up when the wires are placed in a beaker of oil.

fact.en: Many inorganic compounds are electrolytes, meaning they conduct electricity when dissolved in water.
fact.tl: Maraming inorganic compounds ang electrolytes, ibig sabihin nagdadala sila ng kuryente kapag natunaw sa tubig.
fact.bis: Daghang inorganic compounds mga electrolytes, nagpasabot nga magdala sila og kuryente kon matunaw sa tubig.

cards.illustration: A simple circuit with a light bulb that lights up when the wires are placed in a beaker of salt water.

fact.en: Most organic compounds dissolve in nonpolar solvents like oil, but not in polar solvents like water.
fact.tl: Karamihan sa organic compounds ay natutunaw sa nonpolar solvents tulad ng langis, ngunit hindi sa polar solvents tulad ng tubig.
fact.bis: Kadaghanan sa organic compounds matunaw sa nonpolar solvents sama sa lana, apan dili sa polar solvents sama sa tubig.

cards.illustration: A glass of water with a layer of oil floating on top, showing that oil does not dissolve in water.

fact.en: Most inorganic compounds dissolve in polar solvents like water, but not in nonpolar solvents like oil.
fact.tl: Karamihan sa inorganic compounds ay natutunaw sa polar solvents tulad ng tubig, ngunit hindi sa nonpolar solvents tulad ng langis.
fact.bis: Kadaghanan sa inorganic compounds matunaw sa polar solvents sama sa tubig, apan dili sa nonpolar solvents sama sa lana.

cards.illustration: A spoonful of salt dissolving completely in a glass of water, showing solubility.

fact.en: Organic compounds can be large molecules with many atoms, while inorganic compounds are usually small with few atoms.
fact.tl: Ang organic compounds ay maaaring malalaking molecule na may maraming atoms, samantalang ang inorganic compounds ay karaniwang maliit na may kakaunting atoms.
fact.bis: Ang organic compounds mahimong dagko nga molecule nga adunay daghang atoms, samtang ang inorganic compounds sagad gagmay nga adunay diyutay nga atoms.

title.tl: Laki ng Molecule ng Organic Compounds
title.bis: Gidak-on sa Molecule sa Organic Compounds

cards.illustration: A large complex molecule model next to a small simple molecule model, showing the size difference.

fact.en: Ethyne, with the formula C2H2, is an alkyne because it has a triple bond between its two carbon atoms.
fact.tl: Ang ethyne, na may formula na C2H2, ay isang alkyne dahil mayroon itong triple bond sa pagitan ng dalawang carbon atoms nito.
fact.bis: Ang ethyne, nga adunay formula nga C2H2, usa ka alkyne tungod kay kini adunay triple bond tali sa duha ka carbon atoms.

cards.illustration: A molecular model of ethyne showing two carbon atoms connected by three lines and each bonded to one hydrogen atom.

fact.en: Ethene, with the formula C2H4, is an alkene because it has a double bond between its two carbon atoms.
fact.tl: Ang ethene, na may formula na C2H4, ay isang alkene dahil mayroon itong double bond sa pagitan ng dalawang carbon atoms nito.
fact.bis: Ang ethene, nga adunay formula nga C2H4, usa ka alkene tungod kay kini adunay double bond tali sa duha ka carbon atoms.

cards.illustration: A molecular model of ethene showing two carbon atoms connected by two lines and each bonded to two hydrogen atoms.

fact.en: Methane, with the formula CH4, is the simplest alkane because it has only single bonds between carbon and hydrogen atoms.
fact.tl: Ang methane, na may formula na CH4, ay ang pinakasimpleng alkane dahil mayroon lamang itong single bonds sa pagitan ng carbon at hydrogen atoms.
fact.bis: Ang methane, nga adunay formula nga CH4, mao ang pinakasimple nga alkane tungod kay kini adunay lamang single bonds tali sa carbon ug hydrogen atoms.

cards.illustration: A molecular model of methane showing one carbon atom bonded to four hydrogen atoms with single lines.
